name: Husayn Abu al-Faraj
bio: Husayn ibn Walid Abu al-Faraj is a Saudi poet and scholar of comparative literature at King Abdulaziz University in Jeddah, where he has chaired the Department of Arabic Language and Literature. He wrote an ode in praise of Ali ibn Abi Talib that Alqimmah Studio released in a recitation by Khalid al-Sharafi in 2023. Jadawel published his collection Al-Qala'id (The Necklaces). At the 2026 Cairo International Book Fair he read poems on Egypt and on the poet al-Mutanabbi.
